# CyberScryb
> Free AI & Developer Tools | Privacy-First

CyberScryb provides free, browser-based developer and AI writing tools. All tools run client-side for maximum privacy.

## Tools

- [Text Readability Improver](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/humanizer/): Analyze and improve text readability to match your personal writing style
- [AI Writing Suite](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/ai-writing-suite/): Multi-model AI writing workspace with style analysis
- [Proposal Draft Generator](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/gig-auto-pilot/): Generate professional freelance proposal drafts
- [JSON ↔ CSV Converter](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/json-csv-converter/): Convert between JSON and CSV formats
- [SEO Tag Generator](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/seo-tag-generator/): Generate meta tags and Open Graph tags
- [Password Strength Checker](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/password-checker/): Check password strength and entropy
- [Base64 Encoder/Decoder](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/base64-tool/): Encode and decode Base64 strings
- [Color Palette Generator](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/color-palette/): Generate harmonious color palettes
- [Markdown to HTML Converter](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/markdown-html/): Convert Markdown to HTML
- [Regex Tester](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/regex-tester/): Test regular expressions with live matching
- [QR Code Generator](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/qr-generator/): Generate QR codes from text or URLs
- [Word Counter](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/word-counter/): Count words, characters, and sentences
- [UUID Generator](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/uuid-generator/): Generate UUIDs/GUIDs
- [Lorem Ipsum Generator](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/lorem-ipsum/): Generate placeholder text
- [Epoch Converter](https://cyberscryb.com/tools/epoch-converter/): Convert Unix timestamps
